Growth roadmap and monetization strategy

Recommended Growth Roadmap

4-phase approach to scaling the business
PHASE 1: Months 1-6

Start with Consulting

Focus on implementation services and building case studies
Target Revenue
$30K-60K
Key Actions:
• Offer 3 free implementations
• Get testimonials
• Start charging $10K/project
• Build website and brand
PHASE 2: Months 7-12

Add Partner Licensing

Scale through partners while continuing consulting
Target Revenue
$50K-100K
Key Actions:
• Create partner program
• Sign 5-10 partners
• Develop partner materials
• Add recurring revenue
PHASE 3: Year 2

Launch Direct Sales

Start selling licenses directly to organizations
Target Revenue
$150K-300K
Key Actions:
• Launch sales website
• Implement payment processing
• Run marketing campaigns
• Sell 20-50 licenses
PHASE 4: Year 3+

Scale with SaaS

Add hosted solution for recurring revenue
Target Revenue
$300K-1M+
Key Actions:
• Build SaaS platform
• Launch subscription tiers
• Scale marketing
• Hire team if needed

🛡️ Risk Contingency & Mitigation

Proactive strategies to reduce portfolio risk

🚨 Schedule Contingency - Cloud Migration

Add 2-week schedule buffer to critical path. Historical data shows 78% of similar projects experience deployment delays.

Trigger: SPI drops below 0.85 or milestone variance > 5 days
Cost: $45K (resource extension)
Impact: Reduces schedule risk by 42%
Priority: High Confidence: 92%

⚠️ Cost Contingency - ERP Implementation

Allocate 10% cost reserve ($320K) due to CPI of 0.84. AI predicts 68% probability of cost overrun without intervention.

Trigger: CPI < 0.85 or budget variance > 8%
Reserve: $320K from management reserve
Impact: Covers scope increase + quality fixes
Priority: High Confidence: 87%

💼 Resource Contingency - All Projects

3 key personnel on ERP project have no backup resources. AI predicts 34% risk of unplanned absence impacting timeline.

Trigger: Single point of failure on critical path
Action: Cross-train 2 backup resources per role
Impact: Reduces resource risk by 67%
Priority: Medium Confidence: 89%

📋 Scope Contingency - Mobile App

Identify 15% of scope as "nice-to-have" features that can be descoped if schedule or budget constraints emerge.

Trigger: SPI < 0.80 or CPI < 0.80
Action: Defer Phase 2 features to future release
Impact: Saves 8 weeks + $120K
Priority: Low Confidence: 94%
